summary: This clinical study tests a GLP-1 receptor agonist drug combined with total neoadjuvant therapy for patients with locally advanced rectal cancer and an increased body mass index. Total neoadjuvant therapy means treatment given before the main surgery, such as chemotherapy and radiation therapy. Researchers want to see how this combination affects weight loss, tissue responses, and inflammation. The trial has a status of Not yet recruiting and aims to include 42 participants.
